items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Marzell, he played trumpet with us.

ctx.x: he played with us too, Fredo.

Why the drums? Marzell, he played trumpet with us. He liked. And we had a boy by the name of Lawrence Dewey. He was famous in playing music. Why did he play? He played clarinet. I don't know him. You know him? He's at Lafayette, huh? Yeah, Lafayette. I'm planning to go there and spend a few days with him. Well you'll be sure and tell him how long for this to live. How long for this to live? Yeah. How long for this to live? How long for this to live? How long for this to live? How long for this to live? How long…
Well, you'll be sure and tell him hello for me. All right. I'm married from Bro. I guess you know Wilman Bro.
